description: CGHS claim processing policy rules for NIYANTRA prototype

rules.name: Claim exceeds approved CGHS rate
rules.description: The claimed amount is higher than the approved package rate for this procedure.

rules.name: Possible duplicate claim detected
rules.description: A claim for the same procedure and beneficiary has already been filed recently.

rules.name: Required document missing
rules.description: One or more required supporting documents are not present in the claim file.

rules.name: Beneficiary information conflict
rules.description: Beneficiary details in the claim do not match the registered CGHS beneficiary record.

rules.name: High value claim threshold
rules.description: Claim amount exceeds ₹1,00,000 and requires additional verification.
